description: Hand-authored synthetic catalog, academic record and enrollment ledger for one fictional university and term (the default seed), plus six generated scenario seeds on a larger synthetic catalog. Not a benchmark task and not derived from any real institution's catalog or student records.

sources.description: Hand-authored synthetic records; no external collection, scraping or copied course catalog.

The six seeds in fixtures/scenarios/, written by the package's own generator from a hand-authored fictional catalog and scenario definitions. Background occupancy uses a fixed-seed generator; offers, notices and receipts are produced by running the App's handlers. expected_counts below describes the default seed only; a scenario seed is loaded without a bundle.

transformations: Normalized timestamps to the university's UTC offset and assigned stable record IDs.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
